stories.title: Install and configure next-intl
stories.description: Install next-intl package and configure it for Next.js App Router with English (en) as default and Chinese (zh) as second language
acceptanceCriteria: package.json shows next-intl is installed with latest version
i18n.ts configuration file exists in project root with proper locale settings
Default locale is set to 'en'
Supported locales array includes both 'en' and 'zh'
Locale type is properly exported for use throughout the app

stories.title: Create translation JSON files
stories.description: Create messages/en.json and messages/zh.json with all user-visible text extracted and translated
acceptanceCriteria: messages/en.json exists with all English translations
messages/zh.json exists with all Chinese translations
Both files contain identical key structures for all UI text
Vision text is included: 'Dedicated to providing permanently free practical tools for lean enterprises' (EN) and '致力于提供永久免费的精益企业各类实用工具' (ZH)
Main description is included for both languages
All service names are translated (Mail Service/邮件服务, ZPL Printer/ZPL打印工具, Creform Design/Creform 设计, Lean Encyclopedia/精益百科)
Admin info section labels are translated
Footer copyright text is translated

stories.title: Set up Next.js middleware for locale routing
stories.description: Create middleware.ts that handles locale detection and routing, redirecting root / to /en
acceptanceCriteria: middleware.ts file exists in project root
Middleware implements localeMatcher: 'bestsuit' for automatic locale detection
Root path / redirects to /en for default locale
Middleware only processes locale paths and ignores API routes, static files, and Next.js internals
Locale is extracted from URL pathname and stored in cookie

stories.title: Restructure app directory for i18n routing
stories.description: Move existing page and layout files into app/[locale]/ directory structure for next-intl
acceptanceCriteria: app/[locale]/layout.tsx exists with proper NextIntlClientProvider setup
app/[locale]/page.tsx exists with the main page content
Root layout.tsx is updated to pass params to locale layout
All existing functionality (dark theme, responsive design, gradients) is preserved
HTML lang attribute is dynamically set based on locale
File structure matches next-intl App Router requirements

stories.title: Implement language switcher component
stories.description: Create a language switcher dropdown/toggle in the navigation bar that allows users to switch between English and Chinese
acceptanceCriteria: Language switcher component exists in the navigation bar
Switcher displays current language (EN/中文)
Clicking the switcher shows a dropdown with both language options
Selecting a language navigates to the corresponding locale path (/en or /zh)
Switcher maintains position and styling in responsive design
Current locale is highlighted in the dropdown
Switcher uses Link component for client-side navigation

stories.title: Replace hardcoded text with useTranslations hooks
stories.description: Replace all hardcoded Chinese and English text in the page component with useTranslations hooks from next-intl
acceptanceCriteria: All hardcoded strings in page.tsx are replaced with useTranslations() calls
Navigation tab labels use translations
Vision section uses translations and is styled with larger font
Main description uses translations
Service cards use translated names and descriptions
Admin info section labels use translations
Server configuration section uses translations
Footer text uses translations
No hardcoded user-visible text remains in the component
